export_controls.text:
Trump once called wind turbines a threat. Turns out the real threat was selling AI chips abroad while padding his family’s pockets. 
https://t.co/RrRkQLAOj9

deepseek.reason: The speaker calls selling AI chips abroad the real threat, implying support for restricting those exports.
deepseek.confidence_reason: Support is implicit in criticism of chip sales abroad rather than an explicit call for export controls.

astra.reason: He argues against overseas AI chip sales by calling them a threat.
astra.confidence_reason: The criticism supports restricting sales, though its scope and relationship to the alleged self-dealing are unspecified.
